title: Synthetic Assurance and Independent Recovery Proof

full_gate.skip_classification: Accepted baseline/out-of-scope TestF09aPathEscape symlink case for deferred general FilesystemAdapter; no mandatory E01 proof skipped.

exact_snapshot_and_restore.description: Exact unique 20-table authenticated inventory, frozen V1 migration verification, fail-closed sequence/deletion acquisition, exclusive isolated SQLCipher restore, canonical content and integrity validation.

atomic_activation_and_faults.description: Separate scoped atomic activation and four deterministic failure phases preserve active main/WAL/SHM bytes and canonical per-table semantic digests.

independent_recovery.description: Production vault init and recovery CLI use separate Argon2id material without original raw VMK, retained backup key, retained DB key, OS wrapper, or raw VMK command argument.

windows_production_boundary.description: Windows source and destination-parent handles remain verified through handle-relative publication/activation; ambiguous identity fails closed; deterministic mid-operation target swap cannot redirect outside writes.

truthful_validator.description: Read-only evidence validation rejects missing, stale, future, forbidden-state, wrong-baseline, missing-artifact, empty-digest, wrong-digest and contradictory evidence.

rollback_claim.supported: Authenticated sequence consistency with the package's own vault manifest history.
rollback_claim.not_claimed: Detection of a valid older package in a fresh context without a trusted external sequence floor.

residual_risks: No external trusted monotonic rollback floor exists in accepted E00 architecture.
Administrator/SYSTEM, hostile kernel/driver, and trusted-process code execution are outside the E01 Windows boundary.
Independent human crypto/recovery review is still required.
